title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Bar Chart — Household Water Use by Purpose in Four Cities
prompt: The bar chart below shows the average daily water consumption per household, measured in litres, for four different purposes in four cities (Aster, Brimford, Calden, and Dovetail) in 2023. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为限时写作练习（建议20分钟）。图表与数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试题。请先花约3分钟读图：确认单位（升/户/日）、四个城市与四类用途，并找出最高值、最低值及城市之间的差异。写作时先写一句改写题目的引言，再写概述段（2–3个主要特征，不列举所有数字），最后用1–2段比较具体数据。只描述图表信息，不解释原因，不发表个人观点。注意使用比较级、比例表达和准确的数字引用。
